standards.name: Decisions Needed
test: Open the latest steering-committee status report in Confluence and locate the Decisions Needed section
Check each open decision in the Confluence report lists the options considered, a recommendation, and a decision-due date
Open the governance matrix in Confluence and check it defines the next escalation tier and timeframe for stale items
Flag any decision past its due date in the report and trace its escalation record in the PPM tool (Clarity)
Check closed decisions in the Confluence report record the chosen option, the deciding authority, and the date resolved
Pass when every open decision shows options, recommendation and due date and no overdue item lacks a decision or escalation

standards.name: Deliverable Acceptance
test: Open the project closure package in the PPM tool (Clarity) and list every deliverable from the project charter
Match one signed Deliverable Acceptance Form in the PPM repository to each charter deliverable with no unsigned gaps
Open the open-item log in the PPM tool for any deliverable not fully accepted and check deficiency, owner, and due date
Compare each form's signatory in the PPM tool against the charter's authorization matrix
Pass when every deliverable has a signed form from the charter-designated approver or a documented exception with owner and date

standards.name: Dependencies Identified
test: Open the last two sprints on the board in Jira and select five backlog items committed in those sprints
Check each item in Jira shows a populated Dependencies field or linked dependency ticket dated before sprint start
Check each dependency in Jira carries the dependent team's acknowledgment recorded before sprint commitment
Filter the backlog in Jira for items flagged dependency unacknowledged and confirm none sit in an active or completed sprint
Pass when all five sampled items show acknowledged pre-commitment dependencies and no unacknowledged item entered a sprint

standards.name: Dependencies Identified
test: Open the program board from the most recent PI Planning event in Jira Align
Check every dependency on the board in Jira Align names the owning team, the dependent team or external group, and a date
Open the plan-review session notes in Confluence and confirm dependencies were raised and boarded during the event, not after
Pass when the final committed board contains zero dependencies without an owner or a scheduled date

standards.name: Design for Failure
test: Open the ADRs for the three highest-criticality services in Confluence and check retry, circuit-breaker, and fallback rules
Run the fault-injection job against non-production in the CI pipeline (GitHub Actions) simulating one dependency outage
Read the run output in GitHub Actions and confirm a degraded response within the timeout and a breaker trip at threshold
Open the alert rules in the monitoring platform (Grafana) and check breaker trips and retry exhaustion page the on-call team
Search alert history in Grafana for at least one detected and responded event in the past 90 days
Open the CI runs for two services in GitHub Actions and confirm dependency-failure negative-path tests exist and pass
Pass when all three services document the controls, the injected outage degrades gracefully, and negative-path tests pass

standards.name: Detailed Design Reviewed by Peers
test: Select three detailed design pages delivered in the past quarter in Confluence
Open each design's peer-review record in Confluence and check a named reviewer from outside the authoring team with org unit
Open each finding register in Confluence and check every comment has an id, a disposition, an author response, and a close date
Open the linked build ticket in Jira and confirm the design-review-passed gate was set only after all findings were closed
Compare the gate timestamp in Jira against the earliest build commit on the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when all three designs show external review, fully dispositioned findings, and gate approval before the first commit

standards.name: Distributed Tracing Enabled
test: Query the tracing platform (Jaeger) for every production service in the service inventory over the prior 7-day period
Confirm in Jaeger that no inventoried service shows zero spans for the period
Open one quote-to-issue trace in Jaeger and check context flows across HTTP calls, a queue handoff, and a scheduled job
Open the tracing config of three services (HTTP, messaging, batch) in GitHub Enterprise and check W3C or B3 header propagation
Run the latency-injection test on a staging service and locate the slow span and operation in the Jaeger UI
Pass when all inventoried services emit spans over 7 days and the sampled trace is unbroken with the slow span isolated

standards.name: Encryption and Masking Applied
test: Run the encryption posture scan across all PII data stores in the cloud security posture tool (AWS Security Hub)
Review the scan results in AWS Security Hub for AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit with no deprecated ciphers
Run a profiling query in the non-production database for clear-text SSN, bank account, and date-of-birth values
Open the masking standards document in Confluence and check an approved technique per element with a current-cycle approval
Run a profiling report on one analytical dataset in the warehouse and confirm no raw SSN or bank detail columns remain
Pass when all PII stores scan compliant, non-production shows zero clear-text identifiers, and the standard is approved

standards.name: Escalation Path Defined
test: Open the escalation procedure page in Confluence and check three tiers with a named response timeframe at each tier
Export the data dispute log for the trailing 6 months from the governance module in ServiceNow ITSM
Trace each dispute in ServiceNow ITSM through the tiers and check timeframes were met or a fast-track rationale is recorded
Check each fast-tracked issue in ServiceNow ITSM cites regulatory or financial-reporting exposure and a decision within SLA
Pass when the procedure defines all tiers with timeframes and every logged dispute met them or was fast-tracked with rationale

standards.name: Escalation Triggers
test: Open the escalation-trigger ruleset in the PPM tool (Clarity) and check numeric thresholds for reds, variance, and milestones
Export the last three months of portfolio status reports from the PPM tool and flag initiatives that met a trigger
Open the board exception agenda in Confluence and match every flagged initiative to an agenda entry within the required cycle
Inspect the escalation workflow in the PPM tool and confirm a trigger breach auto-generates the escalation without manual steps
Open the last quarter's exception agenda minutes in Confluence and check each escalation cites the triggering rule by code
Pass when thresholds are numeric, every breach reached the exception agenda automatically, and minutes cite the rule by code

standards.name: Every Dataset Has Assigned Owner and Steward
test: Export all registered datasets with owner and steward fields from the enterprise data catalog (Collibra)
Compute the share of datasets with both fields populated in the export and compare to the 100% active-dataset target
Sample 10 datasets onboarded in the last 12 months in Collibra and check ownership was recorded by onboarding completion
Run the unowned-dataset report in Collibra and open each flagged dataset's remediation ticket in Jira
Check each ticket in Jira has an assignee and target resolution date or links a documented retirement decision
Pass when 100% of active datasets name both owner and steward and every unowned dataset has a remediation or retirement action

standards.name: Examples Provided
test: Select a random sample of 5 documented endpoints in the API developer portal (SwaggerHub)
Check each sampled endpoint in SwaggerHub shows a request example, a success response example, and at least one error example
Scan each example payload in SwaggerHub for real policy numbers, claim IDs, or names and confirm all values are synthetic
Run each success-path example against the non-production environment in Postman and compare the response to the documented one
Pass when all 5 endpoints show success and error examples, contain only synthetic data, and execute as documented

standards.name: Externalized Configuration
test: Run the secrets scan (detect-secrets) against the promoted artifact in the CI pipeline (GitHub Actions)
Open the application's startup config in GitHub Enterprise and check values resolve at runtime from the secrets manager (Vault)
Review the runtime access logs in the secrets manager (Vault) for the application's configuration reads
Compare the artifact SHA-256 digest in the GitHub Actions registry against the production deployment manifest
Push a test build with a hard-coded credential and confirm the secrets-scan stage blocks promotion in GitHub Actions
Pass when the artifact has zero credential findings, digests match test to production, and the seeded credential is blocked

standards.name: Failures Block Deployment
test: Open the pipeline config for a production insurance service in GitHub Enterprise and check fitness functions are required gates
Push a branch with a deliberate fitness-function violation and run the pipeline in GitHub Actions
Read the run log in GitHub Actions and confirm the build stops at the gate, names the violated rule, and skips promotion
Open the exception register in Confluence and check every bypass in the past 90 days has approval, justification, and expiry
Confirm in Confluence that no exception remains open past its expiry date
Pass when the gate blocks the seeded violation and all 90-day exceptions are approved, time-boxed, and not expired

standards.name: Feature Branches Under Three Days
test: Open the branch list on the repository in GitHub Enterprise and export active feature branches with creation dates
Flag any open branch older than three working days in the GitHub Enterprise export
Open each flagged branch's story in Jira and check it is decomposed into mergeable sub-tasks
Search the flag management system (LaunchDarkly) for a flag entry keeping each flagged branch's unreleased work dark
Pull merge records for the past two sprints from GitHub Enterprise and compare manual conflict frequency against branch ages
Pass when no branch exceeds three working days without decomposition and a covering feature flag

standards.name: Functionality, Tests, Security, Performance, and Maintainability Checked
test: Open the PR checklist template in GitHub Enterprise and check items for functionality, tests, security, performance, upkeep
Select 5 recently merged pull requests on the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Check each sampled PR in GitHub Enterprise shows the reviewer attested to all five checklist dimensions before approval
Check security comments on each sampled PR in GitHub Enterprise and confirm injection or exposure findings closed before merge
Open the CI checks on each PR in GitHub Actions and the scan results in SonarQube and check coverage and SAST passed or waived
Pass when the checklist covers all five dimensions and all 5 sampled PRs show full attestation with passing or waived gates

standards.name: GitOps Workflow
test: Open the IAM role assignments in the AWS console and confirm only the pipeline identity holds environment write access
Sample five infrastructure changes from the past 60 days on the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Check each sampled change in GitHub Enterprise merged via a pull request with at least one peer-review approval
Open the deployment runs in GitHub Actions and confirm each sampled change was applied by the pipeline, not manually
Run terraform apply from a workstation against a managed environment and find the access-denied entry in the AWS audit trail
Review the commit history in GitHub Enterprise for unbroken lineage with no orphaned or force-pushed commits
Pass when only the pipeline can write, all five changes were peer-reviewed and pipeline-deployed, and manual apply is denied

standards.name: Governed Data Sources Only
test: Export the full data source connection list from the admin portal in the BI platform (Power BI)
Match every connection in the export to the certified semantic layer or an approved warehouse schema and flag any other source
Attempt to publish a report from a prohibited source (operational system or personal spreadsheet) in Power BI
Confirm in Power BI that the governance control blocks or forces approval before the report can be saved or published
Open the approved source registry in Confluence and check it was reviewed within the past quarter and matches the platform
Pass when every active connection is approved, the prohibited source is blocked, and the registry matches the platform exactly
